bullets.label: Train-time architecture optimizations
bullets.text: Conducted ablation studies across attention mechanisms and backbones (convolutional ResNet/ConvNeXt, and transformer-based Restormer/SwinGAN) to optimize for inference latency, identifying a 1.8× faster Pareto-optimal configuration.

bullets.label: Post-training optimizations
bullets.text: Engineered an FP16-native inference pipeline in PyTorch and TensorRT, achieving a 77% speedup via op-fusion, optimized host-to-device memory transfers, and a custom CUDA plugin.

bullets.label: Edge compute deployment
bullets.text: Deployed the localized architecture into a containerized (Flask, SQLite, Docker) web platform, eliminating remote SMB file-transfer bottlenecks and cutting end-to-end analysis time by 99%.

projects.title: Compiler-Aware Resolution Bucketing for DETR Models
bullets: Investigating torch.compile shape-specialization overheads during dynamic multi-scale training for modern DETR-style multimodal vision detectors.
Designed a static resolution-bucketing policy minimizing Wasserstein-1 pixel-area distortion, cutting graph compilation latency and reducing training wall-time by 40% on COCO without sacrificing AP.
